# For

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Loops](Language-Features-Loops)

</div>


```blitzbasic
For variable = from To limit [Step amount]
statements
Next
For variable.Type = Each Type
statements
Next
```

## Description

Counts `variable` from `from` up to `limit`, running the statements once for each number. With [Step](Step) it changes by that amount instead of 1, and counts down when the amount is negative. The limit and the step are read once, before the loop starts. [Next](Next) ends the loop. `For ... = Each` walks through all objects of a custom type instead.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
For i = 1 To 3
	Print i
Next
For i = 10 To 1 Step -4
	Print i
Next
```

```text
1
2
3
10
6
2
```
